— 005 · Method

Six steps.
One partnership.

We don't sell seats. We open a research desk for your firm — staffed by editors, accountable to your committee, calibrated to your real exposure.

01step

Onboard

Sign mandate, configure mandate constraints, link custody read-only.

02step

Ingest

Upload holdings or stream positions via API. Editors receive notice.

03step

Model

Our engine runs 12 macro scenarios on your specific exposure.

04step

Editorial Review

A named editor signs every report against an internal house view.

05step

Deliver

Branded PDF, API payload and live console — same data, three voices.

06step

Compound

Quarterly reviews refine the model on your realised returns.
